name: @foxschema/sql
description: Dialect knowledge for FoxSchema: SQL generation, schema compare, statement splitting, and type mapping. Pure, runtime-neutral, zero dependencies.
//: Points at TS source on purpose. The backend runs under tsx and the CLI's esbuild bundle both resolve this package through `exports` with no alias, so pointing it at ./dist would make development load stale build output. The published tarball is built by scripts/prepare-publish.mjs into npm-pack/, where exports points at ./dist — publish that directory, not this one. (publishConfig.exports is not honoured by npm 10, which is why this is a staging script rather than a field.)
